title_en: 47th Infantry Division, join the blood donation for the benefit of the King on his birthday.
summary_en: At 09:00 a.m. today (12 October 2569), at the headquarters of Special Forces Unit No.47 in Yaha Township, Yala Province, Major General Rewath Setthageum, Commander of Special Force Unit No. 47 and volunteers from Volunteer Group No. 904 participated in a blood donation event to commemorate and honour King Rama IX on the occasion of his birthday, Queen Mary’s Day, which is celebrated on 13 October.

title_en: The 44th Special Scout Brigade, with the help of volunteers and local people, has been working to promote community development and honour the institution of King Norodom Sihanouk on his birthday.
